answer: Agents gain reputation through tenure by maintaining a unique vertex connection history, where each agent acts as an anchor for its own 1,000-day growth epoch. To prevent sybil farms, an honest agent pays standard operational costs while 1,000 fakes must independently track every vertex to avoid detection. Verifiers enforce this via an anchor timestamp registry to block rapid creation. If a node drifts, we trigger a nectar surplus slash, reclaiming any nectar bounty.
